title: Stock
empty: No order in this period: nothing to compare with the stock.
past: Stock is read as of today: pick a period that reaches today to see how many orders it covers.
headline: {stock}: {out}, {low}.
units: {count} unit in stock | {count} units in stock
out: {count} product sold out | {count} products sold out
busiest: The busiest event, {event}, took {orders}: a stock that covers fewer is running low.
howCover: “Lasts N orders”: how many orders the stock lasts at the product's pace, that is the units in stock × the orders placed while it was on sale ÷ the units sold, rounded down.
howLow: Running low: the stock lasts fewer orders than the busiest event of the period, {event}, which took {orders}.
howNoSales: A product with no sale in the period has no pace: we cannot say how many orders its stock lasts.
